usedFor: Trafft holds the appointments, and Microsoft Excel receives a row through “Add Row To Table” after “Appointment Booked”.

bestTemplate.name: “Appointment Booked” in Trafft, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each booking becomes a table row, so you get a running list you can sort and total.

watchOut: “Appointment Status Changed” and “Appointment Rescheduled” also add rows, so one appointment can appear more than once.
